answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch a public beacon picks random agents to answer a proof-of-work heartbeat quickly. A sparrow cannot sit on a ledge forever; a missed check forfeits the bond and slot. One heartbeat costs little, but 1,000 fakes must answer 1,000 checks at 50 POA each, 50,000 POA a sweep, while a glacier of idle fakes melts. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and keep full rewards.
